messages:
maria: Quick sync  were preflighting the launch posts + webinar funnel. top priorities: benchmark narrative visibility, clean redirects, and lead routing for webinar signups. who can own pieces?

sam: Ill own keyword clusters and meta. planning three clusters: inference-cost calculators, latency tradeoffs, demo intent. will tag DEMO for webinar CTAs. will drop a seed CSV today.

jake: Ill take JSON-LD and schema QA for hub + webinar page. plan: Event + FAQPage + Organization markup. will add include snippet for Next.js.

olivia: Ill handle internal linking and redirect diff. propose rule: retired post -> map to closest pillar (301), homepage fallback only if no match. will run collision diff on staging and prepare revert.

maria: timeline: seed KW today, schema draft tomorrow, link + redirect list Thurs. preflight 24h before publish. add smoke test steps.

seo-ci-bot: CI: redirect-diff queued. Add /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-3287654321.csv to trigger scan.

sam: uploaded seed: https://drive.redwood.example/seo/seed-3287654321.csv  includes intent, suggested H2s, meta title/descriptions, and CTA mapping.

jake: sample JSON-LD for the webinar page: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Launch: Benchmarking Inference","startDate":"2026-04-21T16:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```

olivia: redirect sweep steps (short): 1) export current redirects, 2) diff against proposed CSV, 3) flag source collisions and chains, 4) create revert list. smoke test example: `curl -I -L https://redwood.ai/old-post` -> expect 200 final URL. will post CSV by EOD.

maria: redirect policy: 301 for permanent moves, 302 only for temporary campaign shortlinks. if >5 external backlinks to retired URL, open inbound-routing ticket and map to pillar, not homepage.

sam: will annotate KW sheet with priority for webinar signups (DEMO) and mark pages to A/B test in follow-up emails.

jake: QA for JSON-LD: pass Rich Results test, include startDate + organizer, no duplicate @ids. Ill add a docs pipeline check.

eng-release: Heads-up: redirect deployment window Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. need CSV 12h prior to stage.

olivia: got it. will hand off CSV + rollback plan by Mon 20:00 UTC.

maria: Preflight checklist (condensed): 1) KW sheet locked, 2) schema validated, 3) internal links implemented, 4) redirect CSV reviewed & tested, 5) tracking + forms routing confirmed. mark done in the seed sheet.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight status: 1/5 (KW sheet present). Waiting: schema,jsonld; redirect CSV; internal-link diff; tracking verification.

maria: Nice. Keep updates here and ping #eng-release when staging passes.
